title: Manyhands JSON v1 request cancellation
description: What request cancel reports of the request it asked to stop. The envelope of this call reports the call itself, so it is a success whatever became of the request. state is where the request stood when it was asked. requested says the request was asked to stop: it is accepted, and its command has a safe point to stop at, which is a synchronization. It is false for a request that is finished and for one of a command that cannot be stopped once it is accepted; neither is changed in any way. acknowledged says the request has stopped for a cancellation: its result is cancelled, or its operation has ended cancelled and the request's next call returns that. A request that was asked and has not reached a safe point since, because a transport call has not returned or because no call of it is running, is requested and not acknowledged.
